d: Turkey has successfully tested the Siper Block-2 — a long-range air defence missile that demonstrated mid-flight retargeting for the first time. With a range exceeding 150 kilometres, it outperforms NATO's Patriot PAC-3 and Europe's SAMP/T system on paper. Built entirely by Turkish firms Aselsan and Roketsan, the Siper-2 is the centrepiece of Erdogan's push for full defence independence — and a signal to Turkey's adversaries that Ankara no longer needs Washington's approval to defend its skies. Cary Johnston brings you the details on Firstpost America.
